title: Tiny Shop - Observability
description: Assignment 1 dashboard: application (RED) metrics, the payment dependency, shop business metrics, node-exporter host resources, and the Part E cardinality experiment.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: COUNTER. Per-second request rate, split by route template. rate() over 1m = 12 scrapes at a 5s interval.

panels.title: Request latency percentiles (storefront)
panels.description: HISTOGRAM. Percentiles are computed from bucket counts over a TRAILING 1 MINUTE WINDOW - 'p95 over the last minute', not since start-up. Accuracy is limited by bucket edges.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: COUNTER ratio. 4xx = the customer's request was rejected; 5xx = we broke.

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: GAUGE. Concurrency right now: +1 on arrival, -1 on completion. Rises when work arrives faster than it completes.

panels.title: Database query duration (p95)
panels.description: HISTOGRAM. Separates 'the database is slow' from 'the payment provider is slow'.

panels.title: Payment call duration - AVERAGE (Summary)
panels.description: SUMMARY. The Python client exposes _sum and _count only, so this is the mean over a trailing 1m window. Python summaries cannot give p95 - the panel to the right does that with a histogram.

panels.title: Payment call duration - p95/p99 (Histogram)
panels.description: HISTOGRAM of the same outbound call. This is where p95/p99 come from.

panels.title: Payment outcomes
panels.description: COUNTER. approved / declined / error / timeout, per minute.

panels.title: Orders placed (total)
panels.description: COUNTER, cumulative since process start.

panels.title: Orders cancelled (total)
panels.description: COUNTER, cumulative since process start.

panels.title: Awaiting fulfilment
panels.description: GAUGE. Up on placement, down on fulfil or cancel. Re-read from Postgres at startup so a restart cannot make it lie.

panels.title: Revenue
panels.description: COUNTER. Monotonic, so rate() gives revenue per second.

panels.title: Avg items per order (Summary)
panels.description: SUMMARY. _sum / _count over a trailing 5m window.

panels.title: Basket value p95 (Histogram)
panels.description: HISTOGRAM. The metric explored beyond the class examples: it answers whether the orders lost during an incident are the expensive ones.

panels.title: Orders placed vs cancelled (per minute)
panels.description: COUNTERS. The two business events that define the funnel.

panels.title: Failed checkouts by reason (per minute)
panels.description: COUNTER. Why checkouts died: out_of_stock, payment_declined, payment_error, payment_timeout. The Part E fault shows up here.

panels.title: Checkout duration p95 by outcome
panels.description: HISTOGRAM. End-to-end business transaction, not just 'a request to a URL'.

panels.title: Stock on hand by SKU
panels.description: GAUGE, one series per SKU. Five products, so the label stays bounded.

panels.title: CPU utilisation
panels.description: Derived from the per-core idle counter: busy = 1 - idle. Machine = the Docker host kernel (see REPORT.md Part B).

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: MemAvailable, not MemFree - page cache is reclaimable and does not count as used.

panels.title: Disk space used
panels.description: Real filesystems only; tmpfs and overlay mounts are excluded as noise.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Bytes/s read and written across all block devices.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Physical interfaces only - loopback and the per-container veths are excluded.

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Runnable + uninterruptible tasks, averaged. Compare against core count.

panels.title: Series in demo_requests_total
panels.description: One time series per distinct request_id. The bounded version stays flat at 2 no matter how much traffic arrives.

panels.title: Total series in the Prometheus TSDB head
panels.description: Every series in memory. Watch the step when the demo counter is switched on: this is the cost the whole server pays.

panels.title: Samples ingested per second
panels.description: Ingest load. Scales with series count, which is why cardinality costs CPU too.
